name: Borgholzhausen (Germany)
description: Horizontal tricolour of red, white and red with a broad white middle stripe, charged at the centre with the city arms of Borgholzhausen (a red wall with chevrons on white).
history: Municipal flag of Borgholzhausen; German municipalities use their flags alongside the arms, the hoisted form (Hissflagge) and the hanging banner (Banner) sharing the same design.

features.role: Borgholzhausen arms — wall with chevrons on white
